limits: The rigid selected sole witness/finite peg measurements are retained unchanged. pi/9 is the existing controller envelope, not a current-source anatomical qualification. Actual moving range, full glove/bar contact, skin deformation, collision-proxy agreement and complete selected art remain unaccepted; no player promotion.

calibration.rationale: The current canonical75 contract omits maxSpineFlexRadians, making the existing controller solve only flex=0. Actual Rookie ride01 has 56/192 grip gaps above 1 cm and a 57.335 mm maximum despite converged COM. Enable the existing controller upper limit pi/9 for this exact selected source; this declares an evaluation envelope, not a measured anatomical range or transferred combined04 pose calibration.
calibration.selection: Existing poseRiding evaluates zero, the signed bound and one interpolated candidate, re-solving the same physical COM at every candidate. It selects the least absolute flex among the evaluated candidates with <=1 mm contact residual; otherwise the smallest observed gap.
calibration.invariants: Keep the exact75 rest, authored segment lengths, physical pelvis carrier, physical COM target, collision proxy, physics state, source garment fields and all selected textures unchanged. Existing upper-spine rotations and COM inverse only.
calibration.nextJudgment: Fresh actual Rookie and Pro recorded input clips, side yaw=0, including chosen flex, grip/sole/COM residuals, limb lengths and complete selected moving appearance.
